import json, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import verify, controller
def go(c,label):
    req={'version':3,'cases':[c]}
    t=time.time(); resp=controller.run(json.dumps(req).encode()); dt=time.time()-t
    line='%-24s %6.2fs'%(label,dt)
    try:
        verify.check_request(req,resp)
        r=resp['results'][0]
        line+=' ratio=%s U=%d A=%d cut=%s ok' % (r['ratio'], r['utility'], r['age'], (len(r['cut']) if r['cut'] else r['cut']))
    except Exception as e:
        line+=' FAIL '+type(e).__name__+' '+str(e)[:150]
    print(line, flush=True)

F=[10**12,10**12+1,10**12+5]
# 1: extreme times, single window
go({'model':'cnn','class_values':[1000]*7,'stats':[10**9,10**9,10**9],'bucket':[512,512],
    'slots':[[0,512,0],[F[0],512,512],[F[2],0,512]],
    'flows':[[1,512,-1,3]],'groups':[],
    'windows':[[0,0,F[2],65535,320,65535,1000,[[1500,2560]]*9]]}, 'extreme times')
# 2: no eligible slot (window starts after last slot)
go({'model':'rnn','class_values':[7]*7,'stats':[5,9,13],'bucket':[4,4],
    'slots':[[0,4,0],[10,4,4]],'flows':[[1,4,-1,0]],'groups':[],
    'windows':[[0,11,20,300,40,0,5,[[1,1]]*9]]}, 'window too late')
# 3: window expires before first slot
go({'model':'cnn','class_values':[7]*7,'stats':[5,9,13],'bucket':[4,4],
    'slots':[[100,4,0],[200,4,4]],'flows':[[1,4,-1,0]],'groups':[],
    'windows':[[0,0,99,300,40,0,5,[[1,1]]*9]]}, 'window too early')
# 4: threshold 65535 vs draw 65535 (must reject)
go({'model':'cnn','class_values':[1]*7,'stats':[1,1,1],'bucket':[2,2],
    'slots':[[0,2,0]],'flows':[[1,2,-1,0]],'groups':[],
    'windows':[[0,0,0,1,1,65535,1,[[0,0]]*9]]}, 'draw==threshold65535')
# 5: zero capacity slots
go({'model':'cnn','class_values':[1]*7,'stats':[1,1,75],'bucket':[3,3],
    'slots':[[0,0,0],[1,0,1],[2,0,1]],'flows':[[1,3,-1,0]],'groups':[],
    'windows':[[0,0,9,1,1,0,1,[[0,0]]*9]]*3]}, 'zero service capacity')
